text:
leo: Quick follow-up from the PM: recurring latency bursts during concurrent backfills. Need owners for remediation, timeline, and proposed SLO split. Can we lock by EOD?

maya: Ack. Observed pattern: backfills + small interactive traffic -> KV cache churn -> p95 spikes 80ms -> 500ms for ~20m. Two prior occurrences in last 4 months.

chris: I can take routing/proto work. Plan: add a batch-only queue + qos tag. Prototype and perf runs in ~10 days.

leo: Maya, you on dashboard and alert tuning? Make a burn-rate alert and a batch-slice.

maya: Yes. Suggested alerts: batch_p95 > 350ms over 5m, interactive_p95 > 140ms over 2m, error_budget_burn > 0.5%/day. Will add tiles and a short playbook.

chris: Proposal for SLOs: split into two classes: interactive p95 <= 120ms, batch p95 <= 400ms. Keep current SLO for interactive by routing.

leo: Product will want options. Maya, can you add cost delta for separate pool? Chris, include rollback plan in your PR.

infra-bot: Postmortem created: https://redwood/postmortems/2026-03-recurrent-backfill-latency 1 owner @leo

maya: Quick cost note: separate batch pool ~+10% infra; keeping single pool and increasing baseline ~+25%. Will validate with cost team.

chris: Action items recap:
- chris: routing prototype + PR + perf runbook (due 2026-04-07)
- maya: dashboard slices, alerts, playbook snippet (due 2026-03-30)
- leo: postmortem update + stakeholder notif (due 2026-03-29)
- chris/maya: SLO proposal draft for infra/product review (due 2026-03-31)

leo: I'll set weekly check-ins until 14 days without recurrence. Invite owners + product/cost.

slo-bot: Reminder: SLO review meeting 2026-03-25 17:00 UTC (recurring).

maya: Small win: add workload_type label to metrics so dashboards can split interactive vs batch. I'll open SDK PR today.

chris: Will also add an automated safety rule: when batch-queue-depth > X and burn-rate > Y, route new batch requests to batch-pool. Manual approval required for throttles affecting customers.

leo: Good. Keep this thread for links only once work starts. Post PRs/docs here so I can mark progress in the postmortem.

maya: ack :thumbsup: will post dashboard PR/link when ready.

chris: ack. Starting prototype tomorrow.

leo: Thanks all, closing loop.
